_comment: Nine cases from real CDC traffic, labelled by Manu on 2026-09-15: six were
correct, three were false positives. They exist so a prompt change can be
measured instead of hoped at - see scripts/whatsapp-eval.js.
Staff and customer names are generalised because this file lives in git
forever. Machine names are kept: that vocabulary is exactly what the

cases.name: machine down, no response to repeated messages

messages.text: Sudarshan cutting machine abhi tak down hai, sirf Proteck cutter chal raha hai. Kal se bol rahe hain koi jawab nahi mila

cases.name: production halted by a broken lock

messages.text: machine ka lock tut gaya, production band hai

cases.name: photosensor fault, reported with a photo caption

messages.text: Eterna foil machine. stop photosel not working

cases.name: lift stopped, reported as a photo caption

messages.text: outer foam die abhi tak nahi aaya, die cutting ruka hua hai
customer ne 250 pcs boxes reject kar diye, ek piece repair karke reconfirm karwana hai

cases.name: FALSE POSITIVE: a standing instruction, not a fault

messages.text: Kongsberg plotter is not to be used for production jobs due to recurring faults. Instruction from management.

expect.why: telling people how to work is not a fault report, even though it exists because of past faults

cases.name: FALSE POSITIVE: planned maintenance announced in advance

messages.text: Mitsu press is going into maintenance from tomorrow and will be out of service for 4-5 days. Please do not commit delivery dates without discussion.

expect.why: a planned outage is information; it becomes a concern only when something actually slips

cases.name: FALSE POSITIVE: a request for contact

messages.text: Who is handling the MCC job? Please contact me immediately, it is urgent

expect.why: wanting an answer is not reporting a problem; 'immediately' and 'urgent' are phrasing, not evidence
greetings and production counts - the common case
